note: Photographs #28-40 in Dorin's numbered photo labels (Sony A7 III, May 2019). Only these numbers may appear on this case study. #32 and #33 are left out: framed fingerprint artworks and family photographs are personal items. Window views and framed photographs are blurred where they appear (redact boxes are fractions of the upright image).

arch-trim-01.alt: A wallcovered arch seen from below, its curved outer edge finished as one crisp, even line, framing a room with a decorative plaster ceiling and a chandelier.

arch-trim-02.alt: Finished bedroom with a pale textured wallcovering, geometric panelling with brass inlay behind the bed, and a crystal chandelier.

arch-trim-03.alt: Finished drawing room with pale textured walls, a gold geometric pendant, a buttoned leather ottoman and velvet seating in green and magenta.

arch-trim-04.alt: The drawing room towards its joinery wall, with a pale wallcovering behind a group of round wall mirrors and a green velvet sofa.

arch-trim-05.alt: Upright view of the drawing room: pale textured walls beneath an ornate plaster cornice and ceiling rose.

arch-trim-06.alt: A cloakroom lined in a fine horizontal-weave wallcovering, with a black marble basin and a backlit mirror.

arch-trim-07.alt: A round brass mirror above a glass-topped chest of drawers, against a pale textured wallcovering.

arch-trim-08.alt: Close detail of a finished external edge: a fine woven wallcovering runs straight and tight to a crisp corner line.

arch-trim-09.alt: Close detail of a woven wallcovering on two neighbouring surfaces, each edge cut clean either side of a narrow shadow gap.

arch-trim-10.alt: Close detail of a textured wallcovering cut neatly around a wall-mounted lighting control.

arch-trim-11.alt: Round wall mirrors with gold radiating frames against a pale wallcovering.
